audit.whatIsWrong: Content layer repeatedly calls the root ability 'W Nature's Grasp'. Per champ-data/_kits/maokai.json, Nature's Grasp is the R (ultimate, unlocks level 6, 130/110/90s CD); the point-and-click dash-root available at levels 3-5 is Twisted Advance, slot W.
audit.why: mid text and whys[2] describe a root active at levels 3-5, but Maokai has no ultimate before level 6 — the ability being described has to be Twisted Advance (W), not the R. The level-6 spike and wants.foe correctly pair with the R timing, so only the early/mid references were mislabeled.
audit.corrected: Swap 'W Nature's Grasp' to 'Twisted Advance (W)' wherever it describes the levels 3-5 root; keep 'R Nature's Grasp' where it describes the level-6+ ultimate interrupt.

audit.why: Level 6 (Nature's Grasp R online) and first-item spikes are already flagged in spikes[] and phases[].
Early-levels-favor-Maokai / late-favors-Poppy shape in content already matches the 53.43% Poppy winrate over a close matchup with a late-game swing.

edits.before: Levels 3-5 stay his: Nature's Grasp W roots your ADC from range and his passive sustain lets him win extended brawls, so only commit E when his Q is down.
edits.after: Levels 3-5 stay his: Twisted Advance (W) roots your ADC off a point-and-click dash and his passive sustain lets him win extended brawls, so only commit E when his Q is down.

edits.before: Level 3 Nature's Grasp W gives him a long root your kit can't answer yet.
edits.after: Level 3 Twisted Advance (W) gives him a point-and-click root your kit can't answer yet.

edits.before: Land W Nature's Grasp root to lock your ADC
edits.after: Land Twisted Advance (W) root to lock your ADC

edits.before: Your R Keeper's Verdict flips the lane: charged, it launches Maokai out of his own W Nature's Grasp range and can interrupt his all-in, so you finally dictate engages.
edits.after: Your R Keeper's Verdict flips the lane: charged, it launches Maokai out of his own R Nature's Grasp range and can interrupt his all-in, so you finally dictate engages.

edits.before: - Maokai Twisted Advance (Root): matchup-defining — Point-and-click root — count its cooldown before stepping up. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep W Steadfast Presence banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Maokai Twisted Advance (Root): matchup-defining — point-and-click root on a 14s (10s at max rank) cooldown; count it before stepping up. - Keep W Steadfast Presence banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.

notes: Real defect found and fixed: content layer confused Twisted Advance (W, point-and-click dash-root, 14/13/12/11/10s CD) with Nature's Grasp (R, ultimate wall-root, unlocks lvl 6) in several early/mid references — a root can't come from an unlocked ultimate at level 3. Left full-layer phases[].side alone (all read the generic placeholder 'Skill' rather than a champion name across every matchup in this file) — content win[] already tells a coherent early-Maokai/late-Poppy story consistent with the 53.43% winrate, but rewriting all 7 side+why pairs with kit-grounded justification was out of scope for this pass; flagging for a dedicated chart-sync pass.
